title: Statement contribution value
description: Value type for contributions on the Statement panel. Each contribution proposes a (partial or full) GSM statement payload for the referenced SubjectIdentity. Multiple StatementShapingKSs may contribute competing statements; Control resolves via ContributionResolver. Incremental schema validation against the resolved Archetyping panel runs on each post.

statement.description: GSM statement payload, expected to validate against the resolved archetypeSchema for the SubjectIdentity (resolution = engine ArchetypeResolver applied to the resolved Archetyping panel value, allOf-expanded).

completeness.description: Self-declared completeness. Partial statements may be merged or refined by other StatementShapingKSs; full statements stand on their own.

shapingMethod.description: Free-text identifier for the shaping method (e.g. 'spring-annotation-extract', 'openapi-operation-mapping', 'llm-behavioral-lift'). Captured for audit and resolver heuristics.
